Cooking for more people? Check the cooking plan, too.

This RecipeFix example takes our Chicken Tikka Masala Original from 4 to 6 servings, with a dairy-free request. Chicken goes from 1½ to 2¼ lb. The broiler step becomes two uncrowded sheets, one at a time, then each batch finishes in simmering sauce.
